enchantments.tooltip: Alchemical Air Attunement: Attacks and offensive spells have a small chance to deal massive electric damage.
Thorn of the Rose: Your attacks have a chance to Exhaust your enemies with no save.
Insightful Resistance +6: Passive: +6 Insight bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.
Insightful Doublestrike 8%: Passive: 8% Insight bonus to Doublestrike. (Doublestrike is a chance to score an additional hit with a melee attack.)
Insightful Doubleshot 5%: Passive: 5% Insight bonus to Doubleshot. (Doubleshot is a chance to score an additional hit with a ranged attack.)
Mythic Ring Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
